_note: SYNTHETIC news feed for the Prompt Queens hackathon demo. Headlines and URLs are illustrative placeholders, not real announcements. published_days_ago is relative to today.

items.title: Claude Fable 5.1 is now generally available
items.summary: Anthropic's most capable widely released model moves to general availability with a 1M context window, always-on adaptive thinking, and effort controls from low to max.
items.why_it_matters: If your orchestrator needs deeper reasoning for synthesis, this is the model to put on the coordinator seat.

items.title: Managed Agents: multi-agent orchestration expands to all Console workspaces
items.summary: Coordinator agents can now roster up to 20 sub-agents, spawn multiple copies of each, and delegate in parallel threads inside a single session.
items.why_it_matters: This is the exact pattern Regina uses: one coordinator, a roster of specialists, parallel fan-out.

items.title: Agent Skills marketplace opens to enterprise customers
items.summary: Organizations can publish and share custom Skills (SKILL.md bundles) across workspaces, with versioning and access controls.
items.why_it_matters: Your briefing-format skill could be shared with the whole team instead of copied per agent.

items.title: Claude Code adds scheduled routines and background agents
items.summary: Developers can schedule cloud agents on a cron cadence and run long tasks in the background with notifications on completion.
items.why_it_matters: A morning briefing is a natural scheduled routine.

items.title: Server-side refusal fallbacks reach general availability
items.summary: Requests that hit a safety refusal on a frontier model can automatically re-run on a fallback model within the same API call.
items.why_it_matters: Improves reliability for autonomous agents that must always return something.

items.title: Claude in Chrome available to all Max and Team subscribers
items.summary: The browser agent leaves preview, adding site-level permissions and form-filling improvements.
items.why_it_matters: A browsing subagent could join Regina's roster next.

items.title: Research: measuring delegation quality in coordinator-subagent systems
items.summary: A study of how brief clarity, report format, and parallelism affect multi-agent task success, with prompt recommendations for coordinators.
items.why_it_matters: Directly applicable to how Regina writes briefs for her subagents.

items.title: Prompt caching adds 1-hour TTL by default on Opus-tier models
items.summary: Cached prefixes on Opus-tier models now persist for an hour, cutting costs for agents that re-send stable system prompts.
items.why_it_matters: Keep Regina's system prompt stable and put the date after the cache breakpoint.
